page.overview:
Who is Mol Beldun?

Mol Beldun was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Brought into the Jedi Order early in his life, Beldun was trained at the experimental Almas Academy in the Cularin system as opposed to the academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. After training one-on-one with a Jedi Master and passing his Trials of Knighthood, Beldun was elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight.

In 31 BBY, Beldun was sent to the Jedi enclave in the city Gadrin, on the planet Cularin by the Almas Academy. Ordered to represent the Almas Academy during the celebrations for Cularin's 200th anniversary since it was colonized, Beldun was to ensure that the Padawans in attendance were acting appropriately and where they needed to be. He also spoke to several Masters, directing them towards Initiates in need of a master.
